name: manual_9fb795
claim: Prove a documentation-only commit with a comment-stripped AST or token comparison, not by reading the diff.

decisions.notes: A split of a one-line function body changed a token; the stripped comparison caught it and a docstring pass was proved clean across 99 launcher items.

rationale: A split of a one-line function body changed a token; the stripped comparison caught it and a docstring pass was proved clean across 99 launcher items.
